## 1. Error workflow
Every other flow has *Settings › Error workflow* = this one. When a **production** execution fails, n8n starts the **Error Trigger** with the workflow name, the failed node, the message and the execution id → **Code** formats it → **Telegram**.
(Manual test runs do not trigger it.)

## 2. Daily health check (what n8n cannot see by itself)
A VM cron (`health.sh`, 08:30) writes `health.json`: age of every backup, latest job radar, disk, RAM, stopped containers, n8n /healthz.
**Code** applies the limits and returns **nothing** when all is fine (no noise) and HTML-escapes every value, so **Telegram** only fires with problems — plus a ✅ summary on Mondays, so silence never hides a dead alert system.
